== Biography ==
'''Jane Glasgow''' was born about 1842 in County Antrim, Ireland. The surviving 1851 census records her in the mortality portion of [[Glasgow-1049|Robert Glasgow]]'s household at Donbought, Dunaghy, as his five-year-old daughter who died during the winter of 1847. [[Dunseeth-1|Margaret Glasgow]] was recorded as Robert's wife, and both spouses gave 1833 as their first-marriage year.<ref name="Census1851">[http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Donbought/16/ Census of Ireland, 1851], Donbought, Dunaghy, County Antrim, household 16.</ref>
